name: otak-committer-release-tools
description: Pinned publishing CLIs used only by .github/workflows/release.yml; kept separate from the extension's own dependencies.
//: ovsx 1.2.0 asks for @vscode/vsce ^3.7.1, whose 3.x tree has high-severity advisories. ovsx only calls vsce when it packages the extension itself; the release workflow always hands it a prebuilt .vsix, so it is pointed at the same vsce as the root.
